MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 8, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, BRIDGE DECK, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54273  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, July 11, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54274  Recommendation to approve the placement of a memorial bench to replace an
  existing standard bench in Colorado Lagoon to honor Lori Steiner Reed. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54275  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54276  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54277  Recommendation to receive and file the Commission’s Ad Hoc committee letter
  regarding access support for “Point of Historical Interest” designation in Downtown
  Tidelands.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
